vehicle.notes: UK RHD. Kia LH/RH = the vehicle's own left/right (LH = UK nearside/passenger side, RH = UK offside/driver side). Numbers come from web-search result titles and extracts of the cited pages, mostly eBay UK breaker listings and new replacement parts that quote the OE number; no page could be fetched and no Kia UK parts shop turned up in the results. Several numbers were quoted in search extracts of eBay UK category pages without the listing's own URL: for those the category page is cited and the notes say so. Facelift from 2018: pre-facelift or facelift fit is noted per part. GT-Line has its own bumpers, grille and lamps; GT-Line numbers are marked as variants. Headlamp suffixes differ by lamp type and market (a xenon LH unit listed as LHD used 92101-F1100; the UK xenon RH unit is 92102-F1130), so use the UK numbers here. Not found: grilles (numbers appeared only without a usable source), front bumper reinforcement and brackets, mirror glass for UK cars, complete mirrors and covers, front left door, rear doors, RH fog lamp, radiator, cooling fan, parking sensors, wheels. Verify every number by VIN.
